name: Dev Canary Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest

  deploy-modal:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      MODAL_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MODAL_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install modal
      - run: bash distributed/deploy/modal-deploy.sh

  deploy-railway:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RAILWAY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: |
          curl -sL https://cli.railway.app | sh
          echo "$HOME/.railway/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - run: railway login --token $RAILWAY_TOKEN
      - run: railway init
      - run: railway up

  deploy-fly:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: |
          curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.fly/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - run: flyctl auth login --access-token $FLY_API_TOKEN
      - run: bash distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh

  deploy-render:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RENDER_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: |
          curl -sL https://render.com/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.render/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - run: render deploy --token $RENDER_API_TOKEN

  deploy-daytona:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DAYTONA_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DAYTONA_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: |
          curl -sL https://daytona.io/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.daytona/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - run: daytona create --token $DAYTONA_TOKEN

  health-check:
    needs:
      - deploy-modal
      - deploy-railway
      - deploy-fly
      - deploy-render
      - deploy-daytona
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      MODAL_APP_URL: ${{ secrets.MODAL_APP_URL }}
      RAILWAY_APP_URL: ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_APP_URL }}
      FLY_APP_URL: ${{ secrets.FLY_APP_URL }}
      RENDER_APP_URL: ${{ secrets.RENDER_APP_URL }}
      DAYTONA_APP_URL: ${{ secrets.DAYTONA_APP_URL }}
    steps:
      - name: Wait for deployments to stabilize
        run: sleep 60
      - name: Check /health on Modal
        run: |
          curl -f "${MODAL_APP_URL}/health" || exit 1
      - name: Check /health on Railway
        run: |
          curl -f "${RAILWAY_APP_URL}/health" || exit 1
      - name: Check /health on Fly
        run: |
          curl -f "${FLY_APP_URL}/health" || exit 1
      - name: Check /health on Render
        run: |
          curl -f "${RENDER_APP_URL}/health" || exit 1
      - name: Check /health on Daytona
        run: |
          curl -f "${DAYTONA_APP_URL}/health" || exit 1
